tagline: Leading owner and operator of outlet and open-air retail destinations in the United States and Canada
hero_kpi_rationale: Occupancy Rate is the primary key performance indicator for a real estate investment trust like Tanger, reflecting tenant demand and asset quality. A rate of 98% in 2025 demonstrates strong resilience amid market pressures.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leasable space currently rented in shopping centers.
kpis.description: An occupancy rate of 98% in 2025 indicates strong brand demand for Tanger's locations.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate despite pressures on physical retail

kpis.name: Gross Leasable Area
kpis.explanation: Total area available for leasing in shopping centers.
kpis.description: Gross Leasable Area increased from 12.69 million square feet in 2023 to 14.0 million in 2025 due to several acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in leasable area through acquisitions

kpis.name: Rental Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from commercial leases in owned centers.
kpis.description: Rental Revenue increased by 10.7% in 2025, driven by new centers and higher rental rates.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net Income increased by $16.7 million in 2025, reflecting growth despite higher interest expenses and asset depreciation.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in net income despite interest expenses

kpis.name: Rent Spread
kpis.explanation: Percentage difference between new rent and prior rent upon lease renewal.
kpis.description: Rent Spread decreased from 15.2% in 2024 to 9.3% in 2025, reflecting pressure on rental rate increases.
kpis.signal: Pressure on rent spreads despite strong demand

kpis.name: Tenant Allowance
kpis.explanation: Average amount granted to tenants for space improvements.
kpis.description: Average tenant allowance per square foot increased, reflecting more competitive leasing market conditions.
kpis.signal: Rising incentive costs to attract tenants

kpis.name: New Initial Rent
kpis.explanation: Average initial rent collected for newly signed leases.
kpis.description: New Initial Rent increased from $36.64 to $39.53 per square foot between 2024 and 2025.
kpis.signal: Higher average rents despite pressure on spreads

kpis.name: Leasing Volume
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of leases signed for new or renewed spaces.
kpis.description: Leasing Volume increased by 28.3%, rising from 2.25 million to 2.89 million square feet.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in leasing activity in 2025

ai_positioning.summary: Tanger acknowledges emerging technologies including generative artificial intelligence and machine learning as part of its cybersecurity and enterprise risk management oversight. The Board's Audit Committee explicitly monitors risks related to emerging technologies such as generative AI and machine learning to align risk exposure with strategic objectives.
evidence: Board Audit Committee oversight of risks related to emerging technologies such as generative artificial intelligence and machine learning
Integration of technology risks and cybersecurity threats including emerging AI into enterprise risk management process
